mechanism_of_action.plain_language: 7MW3711 is an investigational antibody-drug conjugate reported to target B7-H3 on tumor cells and deliver a cytotoxic payload after binding and internalization.
mechanism_of_action.molecular_action: B7-H3-directed monoclonal antibody conjugated to a cytotoxic payload; binding to B7-H3-expressing cells is intended to trigger internalization and intracellular payload release, leading to tumor cell death.
mechanism_of_action.selectivity: Intended for B7-H3-expressing tumors; quantitative selectivity data not established in the retrieved public record.
